reviews.heading: What Families Say
reviews.review1Text: Mak saya baru discharge dari hospital dan kami perlukan katil dengan segera. KatilCare hantar electric bed pada hari yang sama dan pasang terus. Sangat membantu pada waktu kami betul-betul perlukan.
reviews.review2Text: Rented an electric hospital bed for my father after his surgery. Delivery was quick, the bed was spotless, and they showed us how to use the remote. Monthly rate was very reasonable.
reviews.review3Text: Saya sewa katil hospital dan ripple mattress untuk ayah saya yang terlantar. Tilam ripple tu betul-betul elak bedsore. Staff sopan dan terangkan semua dengan jelas.
reviews.review4Text: We needed a bed for my grandmother on short notice. KatilCare delivered within hours and even helped move her old furniture aside. The bed worked perfectly for three months of home care.
reviews.review5Text: Harga berpatutan dan tiada caj tersembunyi. Bila motor katil ada masalah sikit, depa datang tukar percuma esok terus. Memang recommended untuk yang jaga pesakit di rumah.
reviews.review6Text: Rented a semi-electric bed plus a wheelchair package. Both were clean and in great condition. The WhatsApp support was responsive whenever I had questions. Highly recommend KatilCare.

faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: How much does it cost to rent a hospital bed?
faq.a1: Manual beds start from RM150/month, semi-electric from RM220/month, and electric from RM280/month. Daily and weekly rates are available too. Delivery and setup are included; a refundable deposit applies.
faq.a2: We aim to reply within 1 hour of your WhatsApp and offer same-day delivery and setup across most of Malaysia, 7 days a week.
faq.q3: What types of hospital beds can I rent?
faq.a3: Manual, semi-electric, and fully electric hospital beds — all with adjustable backrest and side rails. We also rent anti-bedsore ripple mattresses, wheelchairs, and oxygen concentrators.
faq.q4: Is the bed cleaned before delivery?
faq.a4: Yes. Every bed and mattress is thoroughly cleaned, disinfected, and function-checked before it reaches your home.
faq.a5: Tempoh minimum sewa biasanya satu minggu, tetapi kami fleksibel mengikut keperluan keluarga anda. Sewa bulanan adalah pilihan paling berbaloi untuk penjagaan jangka panjang.
faq.q6: Adakah anda hantar dan pasang katil?
faq.a6: Ya. Harga sewa termasuk penghantaran, pemasangan dan tunjuk cara penggunaan. Bila tamat sewa, kami datang ambil semula tanpa caj tambahan.
faq.a7: Tilam ripple (anti-bedsore) menukar tekanan udara secara berkala untuk mengelakkan luka tekanan (bedsore) bagi pesakit yang terlantar lama. Kami sangat syorkan untuk penjagaan jangka panjang.
faq.a8: A small refundable deposit is collected on delivery and returned in full when the equipment is returned in good condition. WhatsApp us for the exact amount for your chosen bed.
faq.q9: What happens if the bed breaks down during rental?
faq.a9: Contact us on WhatsApp and we will repair or swap the unit free of charge, usually within 24 hours, so patient care is never interrupted.
faq.a10: We deliver across Malaysia — Klang Valley, Penang, Johor Bahru, Ipoh, Kuantan, Kota Kinabalu, Kuching, and more. Check our locations section for the full list.
